name: Question 3
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨¬(B∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
First, we add a column for the part of the expression that's in parentheses, $B∧A:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we add a column for the negation, $¬(B∧A):$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ | $\,¬(B∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Finally, we add a column for $A∨¬(B∧A):$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ | $\,¬(B∧A)\,$ | $\,A∨¬(B∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
